title: Army Awards Rune Technologies $99M IDIQ for TyrOS Logistics Platform — One Bid Received | Rune Technologies News
summary: The U.S. Army awarded Rune Technologies a $99 million contract for its TyrOS logistics software platform, though the solicitation received only a single bid.
body_markdown:
GovConFeed covered Rune Technologies by Marcus Webb in a piece titled “Army Awards Rune Technologies $99M IDIQ for TyrOS Logistics Platform — One Bid Received.” The U.S. Army awarded Rune Technologies a $99 million contract for its TyrOS logistics software platform, though the solicitation received only a single bid.


Read the full article[here](https://govconfeed.com/article/army-rune-technologies-99m-tyros-ai-logistics-june-2026) .
